finding: Soccer multi-outcome back signals are catastrophically miscalibrated and account for essentially all of the net loss since 2026-07-01. Grouped by market_name across resolved Betfair backs since 2026-07-01: Match Odds n=21 WR=23.8% pnl=-£20.13 (avg edge 8.4pp), Half Time n=21 WR=23.8% pnl=-£15.04 (avg edge 8.8pp), Draw no Bet n=11 WR=27.3% pnl=-£8.70 (avg edge 9.5pp), Winner n=7 WR=0.0% pnl=-£14.00, Both teams to Score n=5 WR=40.0% pnl=-£1.97, Match Odds and Over/Under 2.5 Goals n=3 WR=33.3% pnl=-£1.76, plus HT/FT and Match Odds+BTTS singletons. Combined soccer-multi backs ~n=71, ~17 wins, WR≈24%, pnl ≈ -£63 — versus overall paper_pnl_total of -£30.73 across all sports/sides. The other back families in the same window are neutral-to-positive (Moneyline n=13 WR=76.9% +£15.62; golf named H2H all four wins +£15.12; Top 10 Finish n=5 WR=100% +£9.60), so the loss is structurally concentrated in one segment.
root_cause: MOD-316 (2026-07-13) segmented probe outcomes and its milestone_watcher fired a KILL alert for soccer:multi at n=47/21% WR, but the KILL is only an alert — there is no gate in analyze_research.py that stops probe signals for KILLed (sport, market_class) segments from being emitted on subsequent runs. As a result the pipeline keeps generating probe signals for Match Odds / Half Time / DNB / Winner / BTTS every routine, and — because the model has no soccer-multi-specific calibration and this segment's true WR at the model's ~8-9pp claimed edge is ~24% — every accepted signal is a large negative-EV bet the tracker still resolves at simulated -£2 or small +£. The probe-intake floor added in MOD-300 (back_probe_min_edge_pct=7.0) actually made the leak worse by admitting more of these low-edge soccer-multi probes that used to fall below threshold_pp.
proposed_change: In scripts/analyze_research.py, inside the probe-eligibility block near lines 1886-1929 (where _back_probe is decided and _probe_intake_ok is gated), add a hard denylist check keyed on (sport_type, market_class) that forces _back_probe=False and _probe_intake_ok=False when the segment matches a KILLed entry. Read the denylist from a new config path thresholds.killed_probe_segments (list of "sport:market_class" strings; default to ["soccer:multi", "golf:multi"] if the key is absent — matching the two segments milestone_watcher has already flagged KILL). market_class should map the market_name family the way milestone_watcher already does (Match Odds/Half Time/Draw no Bet/Winner/Both teams to Score/Half Time-Full Time/Match Odds and Over-Under * = soccer 'multi'; Top N Finish/Winner/1st Round Leader/Each Way = golf 'multi'; 2-horse named H2H stays 'two_horse' via existing _is_two_horse). Log a single one-line note ("MOD-XXX: probe suppressed — segment killed (soccer:multi)") when a signal is dropped so the digest can surface the counterfactual. Do NOT change threshold_pp or any placeable-back gate; this change ONLY suppresses probe intake for the two KILLed segments. Non-KILLed segments (basketball:two_horse, golf:two_horse, everything Moneyline, all lays) are untouched.
expected_impact: Direct measurement: at the observed rate of ~71 soccer-multi back probes producing -£63 in ~15 days, suppressing them saves roughly £4/day in simulated P&L (~£120/month) and lifts the resolved-trade backs WR from 42.1% (90/214) toward ~50% by removing 71 trades with only 17 wins. Kelly-replay P&L (currently -£33.90 vs flat -£5.34) should improve proportionally because the eliminated segment is where the flat/Kelly divergence is worst. Brier score on backs should improve because these probes are the worst-calibrated bucket in the current mix. Estimate is measured, not guessed, but assumes rate of soccer-multi probes stays comparable to the last 15 days — could be higher during a busy football week (Premier League returns 2026-08-15) and much lower right now (summer trough).
test_condition: After the change ships: (a) `python3 scripts/paper_tracker.py summary` should show zero new soccer Match Odds / Half Time / Draw no Bet / Winner / BTTS / HT-FT / Match Odds and O-U back trades logged on the next 14 days of runs (verdict at n>=20 blocked signals visible in the run logs — should take ~5 days); (b) recompute back-side WR and net paper P&L over 30 days after the change and compare to the 15-day pre-change baseline (backs WR should rise from 42.1% toward 48-52%; net paper P&L should be at least +£30 better than a matched 15-day pre-change window). Reversible in one line by setting thresholds.killed_probe_segments=[] in config.toml. If Moneyline / golf named H2H WR drops (they should not — the change does not touch them), that indicates the market_class mapping caught something it shouldn't and needs narrowing.

alternative_findings: Winner-market (soccer/rugby) backs n=7 WR=0% -£14.00 since 2026-07-01 — small sample but zero wins across 7 attempts at avg 8.9pp claimed edge is the most extreme WR of any segment; would be captured by the proposed soccer:multi block but worth its own scrutiny if the block is narrowed.

Moneyline backs n=13 WR=76.9% +£15.62 avg edge 8.2pp — inverse of the soccer-multi problem; this segment plus golf named H2H are the only backs earning money and would be strong candidates for PROMOTION out of probe-only tracking (MOD-287) into placeable status, but only after their per-segment n hits ~30 per MOD-316 promotion rule.

12pp+ band overall WR fell to 38.9% (54 trades, -£27.36) — worse than the 7-9pp band at 46.6%. Suggests the edge-credibility cap (MOD-293, max_credible_edge_pct=40) may need tightening further, but the by-market view above shows most of the 12pp+ damage is concentrated in the same soccer-multi bucket, so the segment fix should address most of the band-level anomaly.

top_boost_words is dominated by 'injury' (1133) — worth a targeted audit of whether injury keywords are being applied with the correct sign to the correct team, but no direct P&L signal visible from the aggregate counts alone.
caveats: The 15-day window (2026-07-01 → 2026-07-15) is a low-football period (mid-summer trough between competitions); soccer-multi volume and WR could look meaningfully different once major leagues resume in August, so re-run this diagnosis on 2026-08-31 with a full post-restart window before declaring the block permanent. Also, some of the 71 soccer-multi backs in the sample are probe (£2 flat) trades the operator never actually placed, so the -£63 is simulated P&L not real Betfair loss — but the calibration/Brier evidence and the KILL milestone are still valid regardless of stake. Finally, market_class mapping in the proposed change must match milestone_watcher.py exactly or the block/KILL sets will disagree — the implementing session should import or copy that mapping function rather than re-invent it.
